caption: A player uses a quick set to spike the ball, driving it downward at a steep angle.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Player crouched near net, ball held at waist height, posture ready for motion; no ball in flight, no contact made. Unknown: Whether set motion initiates, trajectory angle, force magnitude, or follow-through control.

INTERACTION: If player initiates quick set motion → ball propelled downward at steep angle via wrist snap and arm extension; force vector determined by muscle torque and limb acceleration.

PERSISTENCE: Downward trajectory sustains until gravity or air resistance decelerates it; player’s follow-through maintains directional control for 0.5–1.0s post-contact, influencing ball’s spin and landing zone.

INTERVENTION: If set motion is absent or weak → ball remains stationary or arcs shallowly; if follow-through is incomplete → ball loses directional control, trajectory becomes erratic or flat. Force and angle remain dependent on player’s biomechanics.
